parameters.content:
## Pexels Stock Media Scraper

**Actor:** [Pexels Stock Media Scraper](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/pexels-stock-media-scraper-2)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/pexels-stock-media-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQuery` (string)
- `mediaType` (string)
- `orientation` (string)
- `minWidth` (integer)
- `minHeight` (integer)
- `minDuration` (integer)
- `maxDuration` (integer)
- `peopleCount` (string)
- `photoIds` (array)
- `username` (string)
- `collectionSlug` (string)

### Output fields
- `photoId` (Photo Id)
- `videoId` (Video Id)
- `title` (Title)
- `photographerName` (Photographer Name)
- `width` (Width)
- `height` (Height)
- `orientation` (Orientation)
- `durationSeconds` (Duration Seconds)
- `license` (License)
- `attribution` (Attribution)
- `downloadUrl` (Download Url)
- `pageUrl` (Page Url)

description: Pexels stock media scraper: runs the Pexels Stock Media Scraper Apify Actor, returns title, photographerName, width, height, orientation and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
